PHYP doesn't activate the watchdog timer, watchdog timer is activated if the boot is completed in a specific time

It should say something like this "By implementing this functionality we can determine which booting subsystem is failed or stopped responding, and the dump can be extracted from the right subsystem."

use constexpr auto eventName = "org.open_power.Host.Boot.Error.WatchdogTimedOut";
More optimized and faster. It will be translated into a const char* datatype for the variable which can be passed to any string object thereafter

Better trace message could be
"PHYP boot failure occured, triggering system dump instead of HB dump"
Just a suggestion
better use host instead of PHYP
Please rephrase, hostboot has completed booting and host started booting. use system dump instead of mpipl dump
Required IPL version bump commit details , which includes this function support

This says that the PEL created doesn't have any callouts.
So not related to this commit, but I think at some point one should get added.
Yes, as discussed we will add call out in message registry in phosphor-logging.
